# goslop text fixture — CWE-88 offline backend/tools OCR pipeline (not app sink)
lang: python
file: backend/tools/ingest_moha_pdfs.py
---
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path


def ocr_pdf_to_text(pdf_path: Path, tmp_dir: Path) -> str:
    prefix = tmp_dir / "page"
    subprocess.run(
        ["pdftoppm", "-r", "300", "-png", str(pdf_path), str(prefix)],
        check=True,
    )
    return ""
